sub_graphs.title: EIP-1884: Opcode Gas Repricing
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost changes for trie-accessing opcodes to reflect actual resource consumption

nodes.label: Opcode Execution Initiated
nodes.description: EVM encounters SLOAD, BALANCE, or EXTCODEHASH opcode

nodes.label: Calculate Updated Gas Cost
nodes.description: Apply EIP-1884 gas costs: SLOAD=800, BALANCE=700, EXTCODEHASH=700

nodes.label: Deduct Gas from Available
nodes.description: Subtract calculated gas cost from remaining transaction gas

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas Available
nodes.description: Transaction has enough gas to proceed with operation

nodes.label: Out of Gas Exception
nodes.description: Transaction runs out of gas and execution reverts

nodes.label: Execute Trie Access Operation
nodes.description: Perform the actual state trie lookup for SLOAD/BALANCE/EXTCODEHASH

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1884: SELFBALANCE Opcode
sub_graphs.description: Models the new SELFBALANCE opcode that provides cheap access to current contract balance

nodes.label: EVM Executing Contract Code
nodes.description: EVM is executing bytecode within a contract context

nodes.label: Decode SELFBALANCE Opcode (0x47)
nodes.description: EVM encounters and decodes the new SELFBALANCE instruction

nodes.label: Charge GasFastStep (5 gas)
nodes.description: Deduct 5 gas for SELFBALANCE operation

nodes.label: Read Current Execution Address
nodes.description: Retrieve the address of the currently executing contract

nodes.label: Lookup Address Balance
nodes.description: Query state trie for balance of current address

nodes.label: Push Balance to Stack
nodes.description: Push the retrieved balance value onto the EVM stack

nodes.label: Balance Available on Stack
nodes.description: Contract balance is now available for subsequent operations

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify how contracts should be updated to handle the new gas costs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume contract developers must manually audit and redeploy contracts affected by gas cost changes. No automatic migration path exists.

ambiguities.text: The statement 'may cause contracts to fail' does not specify which specific contract patterns are affected.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any contract using SLOAD within 2300 gas stipend (transfer/send) or ERC-165 callbacks with storage access are potentially affected.

implicit_assumptions.description: Contract developers will identify and update contracts that rely on hardcoded gas assumptions before the fork activates.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts may permanently break, potentially locking funds or disabling functionality.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas cost increases accurately reflect the actual computational cost of trie access operations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If costs are still too low, DoS attacks via cheap state access remain possible. If too high, legitimate operations become prohibitively expensive.

implicit_assumptions.description: Solidity and other compilers do not generate code that depends on specific SLOAD/BALANCE gas costs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compiler-generated code patterns may unexpectedly fail after the fork.
